history_real_predicates.polygonal_area: exact dyadic shoelace from coordinate bytes; native scalar equals correctly-rounded binary64; cross-route absolute difference <= 2*N_body*(10*r_A)*(2e-11 m)

finite_difference.independently_regenerated: every a+h*d and a-h*d regenerates analytic body vertices, solves a fresh harmonic mesh state, assembles fresh element maps and quadrature, and re-solves Stokes

derivative_observation_plan.reduced_gradient_meaning: complete discretize-then-differentiate derivative of analytic regeneration, fixed-reference P1 harmonic interior motion, affine element maps, sealed quadrature, augmented MINI/P1 Stokes state and gauge solve, and sealed dissipation
derivative_observation_plan.route_comparison_stage: after both routes have independently completed and sealed their ordinary positive outputs

assembly.boundary_lifting: strong elimination of all body and outer P1 velocity vertex degrees of freedom after assembling the full residual; MINI bubbles vanish on every cell edge
assembly.global_dof_order: interleaved P1 velocity (vertex_id,x then y), interleaved MINI bubble velocity (cell_id,x then y), P1 pressure by vertex_id, scalar gauge multiplier last
assembly.pressure_gauge: augment pressure equation by zeta*integral(q)dA and append integral(p)dA=0
assembly.rhs: zero body force with nonzero outer Dirichlet lift only
assembly.signs: the two residual formulas above are authoritative

basis.pressure: continuous global P1 barycentric basis at every topology vertex
basis.velocity: continuous vector P1 at every topology vertex plus one cell-local vector MINI bubble

dissipation.observable: E_h is dissipation per unit out-of-plane length and is never labelled force or drag

element_map.mapping: affine map in listed cell vertex order

nonlinear_solver.reason: the frozen steady Stokes and harmonic systems are linear

quadrature.physical_weight: listed normalized weight multiplied by positive physical triangle area

solver.arithmetic: binary64 or higher precision; report precision and library
solver.convergence: both full augmented residual and pressure-gauge predicates must pass before objective use
solver.factorization: pivoted sparse or dense direct LU of the exact augmented linear system; no iterative early-stop approximation

harmonic_motion.interior_equation: for each Cartesian component and every fluid-interior vertex i, sum_j K_reference[i,j]*d_j=0
harmonic_motion.reference_stiffness: P1 scalar Laplace stiffness assembled exactly on the start-design affine triangles; it is fixed for every derivative and history trial
harmonic_motion.solution_identity: x_i(a)=x_i(start)+d_i(a); body and outer coordinates are imposed exactly before the interior solve
harmonic_motion.wrong_current_geometry_stiffness: contract rejection because the sealed seam uses fixed-reference harmonic stiffness

direction_rule.direction: choose i in {a2,a4} with largest abs(g_i); ties choose a2; p_i=-sign(g_i), the other component is zero
direction_rule.precondition: max(abs(g_a2),abs(g_a4)) exceeds the stationarity threshold and selected component is finite
direction_rule.rationale: L1-steepest coordinate direction gives an exact finite candidate sequence shared by both routes and remains a reduced-gradient descent direction
direction_rule.sign_zero: if the selected component is exactly zero, stationarity is evaluated; no arbitrary sign is selected

history_and_descent.history_digest: SHA-256 of canonical ordered trial-summary bytes under this file's canonical serialization profile; digest is a derived route output, not an input value
history_and_descent.ordinary_history_requirement: the alpha=3/4 proposal is outside the coefficient diamond for the unit coordinate direction and is retained as a rejected trial; a later nonzero proposal must be accepted

stationarity.label_permission: stationary may be reported only when the predicate passes; otherwise the one-accepted-step run ends as budget exhaustion

history_and_descent.terminal_rule: after one accepted nonzero step, evaluate the stationarity predicate on a fresh final gradient only if available within the derivative-solve bound; if false or not evaluated, terminate honestly as budget exhaustion; never relabel budget exhaustion as stationarity
history_and_descent.trial_order: strictly increasing zero-based integer; accepted sequence is the order-preserving subsequence whose disposition is accepted
